changed.title: The 5 by 5 bipartite graph with mask 7865809 is represented on the one-a-side promise by an AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in two with at most 10 gates
changed.statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 10 ∧ PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun u v : Fin 5 => (7865809 : ℕ).testBit (5 * u.val + v.val)) C
changed.unlocks: Whether a NOT gate pays under a checked AND/OR floor of 11 on this side-5 graph, by leaving its classes of equal rows or columns unread.
changed.sketch: We hold no circuit of 10 gates; this is a search. This graph has a class of 2 equal columns, which a circuit with NOT gates may leave unread. Give a gate list of AND, OR and NOT gates of fan-in two, at most 10 gates, judged by evaluation on the 25 promise inputs. The graph needs at least 11 AND/OR gates by a checked floor row (search 'mask 7865809'). An exhausted search is a report, not a proof.

changed.title: Cutting a live circuit at NOT and shared wires partitions its once-read raw inputs into pure and one-entry regions
changed.statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
  let gates := Finset.range C.size
  let gate := PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C
  let reads := PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.readsIn C gates
  let neg := @Finset.filter ℕ (fun k => (gate k).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not)
    (fun k => Classical.propDecidable ((gate k).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not)) gates
  let special := ((Finset.range (n + C.size)).filter (fun w => 2 ≤ reads w)) ∪
    neg.image (fun k => n + k)
  let ordinaryGates := gates.filter (fun k => n + k ∉ special)
  let exits := ∑ k ∈ gates \ ordinaryGates,
    (gate k).inputs.countP (fun w => decide (w ∉ special))
  let entries := ∑ k ∈ ordinaryGates,
    (gate k).inputs.countP (fun w => decide (w ∈ special))
  let once := (Finset.range n).filter (fun w => reads w = 1)
  let tree := fun (S E : Finset ℕ) => ∃ (region : Finset ℕ) (root : ℕ),
    let wires := S ∪ region.image (fun k => n + k)
    let localReads := PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.readsIn C region
    region ⊆ ordinaryGates ∧ root ∈ wires ∧ localReads root = 0 ∧
    (∀ b ∈ E, b ∉ wires ∧ b < root ∧ localReads b = 1) ∧
    (∀ j ∈ region,
      ((gate j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨
       (gate j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧
      (gate j).inputs.length = 2 ∧ ∀ w ∈ (gate j).inputs, w ∈ wires ∨ w ∈ E) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ wires, w ≠ root → localReads w = 1 ∧ reads w = 1 ∧ C.output ≠ w)
  (∀ g ∈ C.gates,
    ((g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧
      g.inputs.length = 2) ∨ (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ g.inputs.length = 1)) →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack n C →
  0 < C.size → C.output + 1 = n + C.size →
  (∀ j < C.size, j + 1 < C.size → 0 < reads (n + j)) →
  ∃ pure chains : List (Finset ℕ),
    pure.length ≤ exits + 1 ∧ chains.length ≤ 2 * entries ∧
    (pure ++ chains).Pairwise (fun A B => Disjoint A B) ∧
    (pure ++ chains).toFinset.biUnion (fun S => S) = once ∧
    (∀ S ∈ pure, S.Nonempty ∧ tree S ∅) ∧
    (∀ S ∈ chains, S.Nonempty ∧ ∃ b : ℕ, tree S {b})
changed.unlocks: supplies original gate sets and single entry wires for the pure-tree and one-entry leaf bounds
changed.context: Follow each ordinary wire to its unique reader. A root uses a distinct slot of a special gate or is the output. At each special operand of an ordinary gate attach one marked leaf. Unmarked trees are pure. In a marked tree keep paths from marks to root. Each maximal run of vertices with one marked child, together with its hanging subtrees, is a one-entry piece. Every raw leaf meets exactly one such run. With e marks the contracted binary tree has 2e-2 edges and one possible top run. Original slots give the witnesses. Gate-price companions cannot exist for this partition.

changed.title: One-a-side promise: the 4 by 6 bipartite graph with mask 272380 has a fan-in-two AND/OR circuit of at most 11 gates
changed.statement: PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun (u : Fin 4) (v : Fin 6) => (272380 : ℕ).testBit (6 * u.val + v.val)) 11
changed.unlocks: the AND/OR cost of 4 by 6 graphs off the square, where the checked twin merge sends square graphs, for the silent-line work
changed.sketch: A search unit. We hold a circuit of 12 AND/OR gates (three plain forms, full lines taken out, equal gates merged and unread gates dropped); at this size those forms are weak; we hold none of 11; this is a search. Our count of unread rows and columns gives a floor of 9 (on paper), a gap of 3. Answer with a gate list (AND or OR, each reading at most two wires; wires 0 to 3 left, 4 to 9 right, gate j writes wire 10 + j, each gate reading only earlier wires) and its output wire, judged on all 24 inputs with one vertex on each side.
